evidence: The Hollyford Track begins at the end of the Lower Hollyford Road, off SH 94 Milford Road, and ends at Martins Bay on the west coast.
The track is suitable for people with good fitness and takes 4–5 days one way. You can return on the same track or arrange transport from Martins Bay.
Cross the swing bridge over Humboldt Creek and follow the old road to the start of the track, which initially sidles along bluffs, with swampland to the left.

doubts: The page describes one 4-5 day track, one way from the end of Lower Hollyford Road to Martins Bay, so kind is one_way; the return on the same track or by transport is not a separate way. The start is F1 (where Hollyford Track meets Lower Hollyford Road), not F2 (Humboldt Falls Track). The end is recorded as the Martins Bay coast (T20), as the text says the track ends at Martins Bay; Martins Bay Hut is listed as the last hut on the way. The 'old road' walk after the Humboldt Creek bridge is walked to reach the start of the track, which does not fit cleanly with the road-end start; it is recorded as a road via with no ref. The distance '56 km one way' is DOC's figure (the section distances sum to about 52.6 km). The Hokuri Creek crossing: the text allows crossing near the creek mouth in low river conditions or using the three-wire crossing upstream, so no ford is recorded. Jerusalem Creek is crossed but the text does not say how, so no ford is recorded. The McKerrow Island Hut side trip is not tied to a point on the way, so from is null; it appears in both side_trips and not_on_route. Long Reef is beyond Martins Bay Hut and belongs to the Pyke - Big Bay Route, which is another walk (L1), so it is not on this way. The Pyke - Big Bay Route return option is not a separate way. Pyke River Lodge, Martins Bay Lodge and Sunshine Hut (private) are recorded as huts the way passes, following rule 12.
